title: Fix music playback audio not playing in Mood Music UI

requirements.text: Debug and fix the audio playback issue in the Mood Music feature so that when a user clicks play on a track, the sound actually plays audibly through the device speakers/headphones.

quotes: but error is not Play song sauond not visble

acceptanceCriteria: When the user selects a mood and clicks the play button on any track in the TrackList, audio plays audibly
The audio element correctly loads the track's local file URL from the catalog
Playback controls (play/pause/seek) respond correctly and the audio continues playing until stopped or track ends
No console errors related to audio loading or playback are present
The mini-player displays the currently playing track and updates its progress bar as the track plays

requirements.text: Verify that all audio file URLs in the mood music catalog (frontend/src/features/mood-music/catalog.ts) point to valid, accessible audio files in the frontend/public directory.
acceptanceCriteria: All track URLs in catalog.ts resolve to existing audio files
Audio files are in a supported format (mp3, ogg, or wav) that works across browsers
File paths are correctly formatted relative to the public directory
Loading any track URL in a browser plays the audio without 404 errors

requirements.text: Ensure the useAudioPlayer hook (frontend/src/features/mood-music/useAudioPlayer.ts) correctly instantiates and manages the HTML Audio element, including proper error handling for loading failures.
acceptanceCriteria: The Audio element is created and properly attached to the hook's state
Error events on the audio element are caught and logged or displayed to the user
The play() promise is handled correctly with try/catch to prevent unhandled rejections
State updates (isPlaying, currentTime, duration) reflect actual audio playback state

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Use only bundled local audio files; do not introduce external streaming services or APIs
Keep all backend logic in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Maintain the existing Tailwind/Shadcn design system and theme variables
nonGoals: Adding new mood categories or tracks to the catalog
Implementing volume controls or equalizer features
Adding playlist management or favorites functionality
Changing the visual design or layout of the Mood Music UI
